ops.title: Agent actions wire facts: kill status, respawn eligibility, wake masking, prompt-open veto
ops.body:
Facts established while shipping the agent actions cut (cc-pane a777703eb6ba + cc-orchestrate 17bc52f), several correcting earlier session recon:

- **`cco agent kill` yields derived status `exited`, not `killed`** — `killed` only arises from repo-level kill cascades. Consequence: an `x`-killed agent IS respawn-eligible (respawn requires status "exited" exactly), so kill→respawn chains work from the TUI. Live-verified both at the CLI and in the dashboard.
- **The "daemon unreachable — retrying" header is normally masked by auto-wake**: the fleet poller's wake spawns `cco fleet status`, which cold-restarts the daemon within ~2s of a kill, so the degraded header only appears when the daemon genuinely cannot restart (e.g. broken binary). Auto-recovery is intended; don't mistake the header's absence for a missing state.
- **OpenTUI two-phase dispatch trap (prompt-open key leak)**: a global keyInput handler that opens the message prompt focuses its InputRenderable mid-dispatch, and `emitWithPriority` reads the renderable-handler set AFTER globals run — so the opening key is delivered into the freshly-focused input unless the global handler `preventDefault()`s exactly the none→prompt transition (see the onKeypress closure in src/app.ts). Tests driven via `handle.route()` bypass keyInput dispatch entirely and structurally cannot catch this class of bug — regression coverage must go through `mockInput`.
- **`cco agent attach <id>`** (cc-orchestrate 17bc52f, bundled into the v0.11.0 window-identity commit): CLI-only — resolves agent→sprint→workstream over the daemon for the backend workspace handle, runs backend focus pre-steps (tmux select-window/select-pane; zellij focus-pane-id), then execs the multiplexer client via the execve seam. Exit 0 on clean detach; one stderr line + exit 1 for unknown/non-active/unsupported (only tmux+zellij implement backend.Attacher). cc-pane wraps it with renderer.suspend() → Bun.spawn(stdin/stdout inherit, stderr piped) → resume().
